rl_heronplume_coat.name: Heronplume Coat
rl_heronplume_coat.desc: A coat of heron plumes sewn over oilskin. Water sheds off it, and so do blows.

rl_keepers_pole.name: Keeper's Snuffing Pole
rl_keepers_pole.desc: The keeper's long snuffing-pole, brass-tipped, balanced for climbing.

rl_lens_shard.name: Shard of the Great Lens
rl_lens_shard.desc: A shard of the great lens. Held to the light it shows a lamp, lit, far away.

rl_tower_key.name: Tower Key
rl_tower_key.desc: A brass key on a loop of tarred twine.

rl_receipt.name: Receipt: the Reedlight
rl_receipt.desc: Received of the Reedlight, the great lens, to see the Well from far off. Ansel says the boats will find their own way for a winter. Held in trust. To be returned lit by spring. The kettle was on. -A.
